channel.title: The Awesome Ledger — awesome-computational-biology
channel.description: New entries across the GitHub awesome ecosystem, diffed nightly.

item.title: sci-Plex — via awesome-computational-biology
item.description: Single-cell chemical perturbation screen of ~650,000 transcriptomes across three cancer cell lines, 188 compounds, and four doses.

item.title: scPRINT-2 — via awesome-computational-biology
item.description: Next-generation single-cell foundation model pretrained on 350M+ cells across 22K+ datasets and 16 species for embeddings, denoising, annotation, gene-network inference, and cross-species transfer.

item.title: scDNAm-GPT — via awesome-computational-biology
item.description: Foundation model for single-cell whole-genome bisulfite sequencing with whole-genome context modeling at single-CpG resolution.

item.title: modernGENA — via awesome-computational-biology
item.description: ModernBERT-style DNA foundation-model family pretrained on hundreds of vertebrate genome assemblies for efficient long-sequence regulatory modeling.

item.title: biolord — via awesome-computational-biology
item.description: Deep generative model that disentangles known and unknown attributes for conditional generation of single-cell states.

item.title: XPert — via awesome-computational-biology
item.description: Knowledge-informed dual-branch Transformer for drug-induced transcriptional perturbation prediction across dose, time, and cellular context.

item.title: Virtual Lab — via awesome-computational-biology
item.description: Human–AI collaborative research environment in which an LLM principal investigator coordinates specialized scientist agents for scientific discovery.

item.title: Virchow2 — via awesome-computational-biology
item.description: 632M-parameter pathology vision transformer pretrained on 3.1M whole-slide images with mixed-magnification self-supervision.

item.title: VirTues — via awesome-computational-biology
item.description: Spatial-proteomics foundation model learning marker-aware representations across proteins, cells, niches, and tissues from multiplexed imaging.

item.title: Uni-Mol2 — via awesome-computational-biology
item.description: Scaled molecular pretraining model using atomic, graph, and 3D geometry features, with models up to 1.1B parameters pretrained on 800M conformations.

item.title: UNI2-h — via awesome-computational-biology
item.description: Billion-parameter histopathology vision foundation model for tile-level feature extraction and downstream computational pathology tasks.

item.title: TxPert — via awesome-computational-biology
item.description: Knowledge-graph-informed latent-transfer model for transcriptomic perturbation prediction across unseen single perturbations, combinations, and cross-context settings.

item.title: TxAgent — via awesome-computational-biology
item.description: Therapeutic reasoning agent using multi-step reasoning and a large scientific tool universe for drug interactions, contraindications, and personalized treatment analysis.

item.title: ToolUniverse — via awesome-computational-biology
item.description: Unified scientific tool ecosystem for building AI scientists that can discover, select, and execute biomedical tools and databases.

item.title: Tahoe-100M — via awesome-computational-biology
item.description: Giga-scale single-cell perturbation atlas with >100 million profiles from 50 cancer cell lines exposed to ~1,100 small molecules.

item.title: TITAN — via awesome-computational-biology
item.description: Multimodal whole-slide pathology foundation model that combines image and language supervision for slide-level representation and zero-shot analysis.

item.title: THERAPI — via awesome-computational-biology
item.description: Cell-line-to-patient transfer framework that aligns tumor transcriptomes with cancer cell lines and integrates perturbation and gene-level representations for patient drug response prediction.

item.title: TESSERA — via awesome-computational-biology
item.description: Cancer-genome foundation model jointly pretrained on somatic SNVs and copy-number alterations from TCGA using masked reconstruction and cross-modal contrastive learning.

item.title: State — via awesome-computational-biology
item.description: Transition model for predicting cellular perturbation responses across diverse contexts and sets of cells.

item.title: STELLA — via awesome-computational-biology
item.description: Self-evolving biomedical research agent that expands its tool repertoire and supports literature reasoning, computational analysis, and laboratory-oriented scientific workflows.

item.title: SCARF — via awesome-computational-biology
item.description: Single-cell RNA+ATAC foundation model pretrained on >2.7M cells for multimodal representation, matching, cross-omics translation, and few-shot annotation.

item.title: RiNALMo — via awesome-computational-biology
item.description: RNA language-model family pretrained on tens of millions of RNA sequences for secondary-structure and functional prediction tasks.

item.title: Replogle et al. 2022 K562 Genome-wide Perturb-seq — via awesome-computational-biology
item.description: Genome-scale CRISPRi Perturb-seq targeting nearly all expressed genes in K562 cells.

item.title: RNA-FM — via awesome-computational-biology
item.description: General-purpose RNA foundation model pretrained on large-scale RNA sequences for structural and functional representation learning.

item.title: Protenix — via awesome-computational-biology
item.description: Trainable biomolecular structure-prediction framework for proteins, nucleic acids, ligands, and complexes with open training and inference pipelines.

item.title: Prophet — via awesome-computational-biology
item.description: Transformer model for predicting cellular phenotypes under unseen chemical or genetic perturbations across heterogeneous assays and contexts.

item.title: PrePR-CT — via awesome-computational-biology
item.description: Graph-based model using cell-type-specific co-expression networks as inductive priors for small-data chemical perturbation response prediction.

item.title: Phikon-v2 — via awesome-computational-biology
item.description: Updated pathology foundation model for general-purpose histology feature extraction and transfer learning.

item.title: PerturbRx — via awesome-computational-biology
item.description: Treatment-conditioned representation learning framework that transfers drug-induced latent transitions learned from single-cell perturbation data to patient-level cancer treatment-response prediction.

item.title: PerturbNet — via awesome-computational-biology
item.description: Conditional generative model for predicting distributions of single-cell states under unseen chemical and genetic perturbations.

item.title: Paper2Agent — via awesome-computational-biology
item.description: Multi-agent system that transforms research papers and associated code into interactive, testable scientific agents and MCP tools.

item.title: PDX-Atlas — via awesome-computational-biology
item.description: Portal integrating clinical, genomic, transcriptomic, and drug-response data from patient-derived xenograft models.

item.title: PASO — via awesome-computational-biology
item.description: Pathway-aware multi-omics drug response model combining pathway-difference features, multi-scale convolutions, Transformer encoding, and drug SMILES.

item.title: OmicsFM — via awesome-computational-biology
item.description: Modality-agnostic molecular-expression foundation model with matched proteomics, bulk-transcriptomics, and single-cell-transcriptomics checkpoints.

item.title: Norman et al. 2019 CRISPRa Perturb-seq — via awesome-computational-biology
item.description: Large-scale CRISPR activation Perturb-seq in K562 cells spanning single-gene and combinatorial perturbations.

item.title: MutationProjector — via awesome-computational-biology
item.description: Pan-cancer genotype foundation model trained on mutations and copy-number alterations from >30K tumors for clinical representation learning.

item.title: MethylGPT — via awesome-computational-biology
item.description: Transformer foundation model for DNA methylation pretrained on >150K human methylomes across thousands of datasets, with 3M/7M/15M parameter variants.

item.title: Medea — via awesome-computational-biology
item.description: Multi-agent therapeutic discovery system combining research planning, biological data analysis, literature reasoning, and multi-LLM deliberation across single-cell, cell-line, and patient contexts.

item.title: MIX-Seq — via awesome-computational-biology
item.description: Multiplexed single-cell transcriptional profiling of chemical and genetic perturbation responses across pools of cancer cell lines.

item.title: LPM — via awesome-computational-biology
item.description: Large perturbation model that jointly learns heterogeneous perturbation experiments by disentangling perturbation, readout, and context representations.

item.title: HiCFoundation — via awesome-computational-biology
item.description: Hi-C foundation model pretrained on large-scale chromatin-contact maps for 3D-genome analysis, epigenomic prediction, and single-cell Hi-C adaptation.

item.title: H-Optimus-1 — via awesome-computational-biology
item.description: 1.1B-parameter pathology foundation model trained on billions of histology images from more than one million slides and 800K+ patients.

item.title: H-Optimus-0 — via awesome-computational-biology
item.description: 1.1B-parameter histopathology foundation model trained with self-supervised learning on a large multi-center slide corpus.

item.title: Genomi — via awesome-computational-biology
item.description: Local-first genomics agent runtime that indexes personal variants, queries evidence, and generates evidence-grounded reports while keeping raw genome data on-device.

item.title: GenoMAS — via awesome-computational-biology
item.description: Multi-agent framework for code-driven gene-expression analysis with planning, execution, debugging, backtracking, and GEO/TCGA-based scientific discovery.

item.title: GenBio-PathFM — via awesome-computational-biology
item.description: 1.1B-parameter histopathology foundation model trained on public data using morphology-aware curation and dual-stage JEPA+DINO learning.

item.title: Gasperini et al. 2019 CRISPRi enhancer screen — via awesome-computational-biology
item.description: High-MOI single-cell CRISPRi screen in K562 cells targeting thousands of candidate enhancers to map enhancer-gene regulation.

item.title: GSE191127 Breast Cancer Pre/Post Chemotherapy — via awesome-computational-biology
item.description: Bulk RNA-seq and genomics from matched pre- and post-neoadjuvant chemotherapy breast tumors with treatment outcomes.

item.title: Frangieh et al. 2021 Perturb-CITE-seq — via awesome-computational-biology
item.description: Multimodal CRISPR knockout screen with RNA and surface-protein readouts in patient-derived melanoma models under immune-related conditions.

item.title: Evo 2 — via awesome-computational-biology
item.description: Genome foundation model trained on 9 trillion DNA base pairs across all domains of life with a 1M-token context window and single-nucleotide resolution.
